besluite.fout: 'Sy' comes straight after 'Lerato vra toe' with only 'Dit'-sentences between, so a Grade 4 reader can take Lerato as the one talking about her talk.
besluite.rede: Naming Suster Nomsa removes the ambiguous pronoun, and present tense with 'later' carries the same future meaning naturally in Afrikaans, so nothing about the content moves.
